name: Meli Dólar
oneLiner: MUSD is Mercado Libre's Ethereum dollar stablecoin issued by Bermuda-licensed Meli ISAC Ltd. for Mercado Pago users, awaiting an admitted price and supply lane.
collateral: Meli ISAC Ltd. states that MUSD is fully backed by liquid, bankruptcy-remote reserves, with monthly audits referenced on melidolar.com. Named custodians, asset-class breakdown and public attestation reports were not retrievable without portal access.
pegMechanism: Meli ISAC Ltd. issues MUSD on Ethereum for 1:1 U.S. dollar parity within Mercado Pago and Mercado Libre flows. Verified contract bytecode permits open-loop ERC-20 transfers to external Ethereum wallets subject to denylist and pause controls; direct non-app redemption terms remain unverified.

proofOfReserves.provider: Meli ISAC Ltd. references monthly audits on melidolar.com; no named attestor or public report was retrievable

jurisdiction.license: Class M Digital Asset Business License (Meli ISAC Ltd.)

launchPhaseDetail: MUSD is live on Ethereum with open-loop ERC-20 transfers verified in the deployed MeliDolar implementation. Operations migrated from Uruguay to Bermuda-licensed Meli ISAC Ltd. in September 2025. Pharos keeps MUSD outside live monitoring because no admitted price or supply lane is available.

milestones.title: Initial MUSD issuance is recorded on Ethereum
milestones.description: The MeliDolar proxy contract is deployed at block 19269600 and mints an initial 1,000 MUSD at block 19270135.

milestones.title: Bermuda Monetary Authority issues Class M license to Meli ISAC Ltd.
milestones.description: Following conditional approval in July 2025, the BMA grants Meli ISAC Ltd. a Class M Digital Asset Business license to issue, sell, and redeem Meli Dólar.

milestones.title: Meli Dólar issuance migrates from Uruguay to Bermuda
milestones.description: MercadoLibre completes the migration of the Meli Dólar business to Meli ISAC Ltd. under its Bermuda Class M regulatory framework.

milestones.title: BMA extends Meli ISAC Ltd. Class M license through February 2027
milestones.description: The Bermuda Monetary Authority extends the Class M Digital Asset Business licenses of Meli ISAC Ltd. and Meli ISA Ltd. for six months through February 18, 2027.

listingStatusReview.reason: No admitted price or supply lane: MUSD is absent from DefiLlama stablecoins and CoinGecko, its DefiLlama exact-contract quote is empty, and DexScreener reports zero pools. Pinned Ethereum totalSupply is positive.
